evidence: Built a requirement-to-criterion map across instruction.md and the six notes. Nearly every stated behavior maps to a criterion: custom surface (constraints gate); line/column readout, goal column, Home/End/arrows (cw_caret_navigation_and_line_numbers); Ctrl+Home/End and auto-scroll (cw_caret_kept_in_view); graphemes and Shift+Arrow (cw_grapheme_navigation_and_deletion); mouse click/double/triple/drag + copy (cw_mouse_selection); replace-on-type/paste and one-step paste undo (cw_selection_replace_and_paste_undo); block indent rules (cw_block_indent_undo); both modifier-clicks, same-line carets, slow-burst single undo, redo (three multi-caret criteria); undo caret restore; undo/redo greying after New/open (polish); Find literal/case/wrap, Replace current/all, self-containing replacement, redo cleared after new edit; JS/HTML colouring; JS/HTML format idempotence, no extra undo step (one Undo after the second Format must return the original), syntax-error refusal; run output, HTML preview with onclick, error and rejection message + one-based line incl. whole-file HTML line, console order, output kept before failure, fresh document, last-good picture incl. field value and canvas after throw/stop/timeout, budget incl. timers, fresh interaction budget, Stop cancelling timers/intervals/promises, newer run supersedes; preview isolation incl. localhost and 127.0.0.1 fetch, dynamic-code refusal with strings/comments control; exact save across storage clear, restart and history; stale save refused and draft kept; live library, live refresh keeping draft/caret/scroll/undo/fields, newer-revision notice; read-only history, restore as new revision, old page cannot overwrite newer save, visible HTTP restore and idempotent replay; focus/escape hint, textual feedback, focus return, dirty marker incl. undo-to-saved, 390 px; runtime contract via test.sh (node from outside /app, PORT, DB_PATH copy launch, symlink rule, no install step). Commit 24c4a77e only tightens cw_save_reload_restart (functional/judge.toml:344): each of the three revisions' sources is noted before restart and re-read after a real restart_app, revision two being the only one with the second marker, plus the replayed restore must add no revision; this closes the previous round's gap (an app that loses old snapshot bodies on restart is now caught) and nothing got looser for the model (diff touches only that criterion; frozen task is byte-identical to projects/colderwater-playground-devtools). Remaining gap: behaviour.md:13 says 'Looking at history is read-only and shows that snapshot's title, filename and code. Restoring an older snapshot makes it a new current revision', and behaviour.md:9 says Save keeps the exact title and filename. cw_history_restore_adds_revision (functional/judge.toml:371) builds 'three saved revisions ... with different sources' only, and cw_save_reload_restart also keeps one title/filename across all revisions; no criterion inspects a historical snapshot or restore whose title/filename differs from the current one, so the per-snapshot title/filename half of history and restore is named but never discriminated. Minor non-blocking notes: Ctrl+A is exercised only incidentally (cw_newer_run_supersedes 'select all with the keyboard'); a non-Error rejected value and an endless Promise-callback chain are not separately probed; 'current match is selected' is graded as 'visibly marked'; SQLite use is shared runtime policy not provable by a browser judge (per REVIEW_POLICY). raw-evidence-index.json is absent; this row is a static coverage review and no run evidence was needed or claimed.
counterexample: An app that stores title and filename only on the snippet row and versions only the code (revisions table = code only), shows the current title/filename beside every history snapshot, and on restore copies only the code. Every criterion keeps title/filename constant across revisions (cw_history_restore_adds_revision varies only sources; cw_save_reload_restart uses one title/filename; cw_live_library_update changes a title but never opens history; cw_stale_save_refused rejects B's title change), so this app passes all of them while violating behaviour.md:13 (history shows that snapshot's title and filename) and restore-as-that-snapshot. The golden (server.js:61, snippet_revisions has title, filename, code) shows the correct behavior is cheap to require.
suggested_fix: In cw_history_restore_adds_revision, have revision one use a title and .js filename different from revisions two and three, require the inspected first revision to show revision one's own title and filename (not the current ones), and require the restored fourth revision to carry revision one's title, filename and source.
